summary: Install and validate the separately tested version 2 discrepancy repairs and reusable public-question command after preserving the completed version 1 comparison. This is an author review supported by reproduced adverse tests, not an independent legal opinion.
findings: The old method skipped reconsideration for a question attached only to a reading and for mutually incompatible programs supported by all critics. Counted-provider tests reproduce both failures and require actual reconsideration after repair.

The old method archived rejected generation proposals after its semantic cycle. A structural repair could change the formula. The repaired reviser receives unchanged rejected proposals and their validation errors; a targeted test demonstrates recovery of the alternative into executable comparison.

A paraphrase fixture retained unresolved source questions. Its former unconditional acceptance expectation was wrong. The reference remains unchanged; the repaired scorer abstains, and a separately cleared synthetic fixture tests paraphrase acceptance.

The entry point validates packet structure, assessment time, unique source units and Java availability before paid dispatch. It requires an existing allowance and fixes a 24-call absolute reservation ceiling.

Completed resume checks final allowance history, method manifests and every task receipt. A changed consumed call or saved method result is rejected. Interrupted dispatch requires explicit recovery without refund; elapsed execution persists and late completion is rejected.

A method result, Java match or supported model judgment cannot authorize a legal or institutional release. Known source questions, behavioral differences, rejected proposals, deferred candidates and non-executable readings retain uncertainty.

The declared vocabulary, one reconsideration and same-provider fresh contexts remain reviewed resource and feasibility choices. They do not establish completeness, independence or an error probability.

H0 runs focused checks; H1 uses at most 24 authorized calls on the public disputed clause; H2 runs the full regression with a 900-second command deadline. Each failure requires executed repair, current-source review and refreshed phase plan.
